name: α-methyl-5-HT
summary: α-Methylserotonin (αMS), also known as α-methyl-5-hydroxytryptamine (α-methyl-5-HT) or as 5-hydroxy-α-methyltryptamine (5-HO-αMT), is a tryptamine derivative closely related to the neurotransmitter serotonin (5-HT). It acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist and has been used extensively in scientific research to study the function of the serotonin system.

pharmacology.text: αMS is a non-selective and near-full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors. It has similar affinity for the 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.

uses.text: According to Alexander Shulgin in his book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), αMS is well-studied in preclinical research but has not been tested in humans.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. According to Alexander Shulgin it has never been tested in people. It is a laboratory tool, and its effects and risks in people are unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。根據Alexander Shulgin的說法，它從未在人體測試過。它是實驗室工具，在人體的作用與風險都不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。根据Alexander Shulgin的说法，它从未在人体测试过。它是实验室工具，在人体的作用与风险都不明。

fact.en: It is serotonin with a single methyl group added, which stops enzymes breaking it down as quickly. That is why it has been used so widely in laboratories in place of serotonin itself.
fact.zh: 它是血清素加上一個甲基，而這讓酵素無法那麼快把它分解。這也是為什麼實驗室常常用它來取代血清素本身。
fact.zhHans: 它是血清素加上一个甲基，而这让酵素无法那么快把它分解。这也是为什么实验室常常用它来取代血清素本身。
